# Subway Seat for Konsole

Background, foreground and the eight colours, each with intense (bright) and faint variants.

[Konsole](https://konsole.kde.org) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/konsole/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.colorscheme`](subway-seat.colorscheme) | ~/.local/share/konsole/subway-seat.colorscheme |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.colorscheme`](subway-seat-tunnel.colorscheme) | ~/.local/share/konsole/subway-seat-tunnel.colorscheme |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.colorscheme`](subway-seat-enamel.colorscheme) | ~/.local/share/konsole/subway-seat-enamel.colorscheme |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Settings › Edit Current Profile › Appearance, or the profile file:

```ini
# ~/.local/share/konsole/<your profile>.profile
[Appearance]
ColorScheme=subway-seat
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Settings › Edit Current Profile › Appearance, or the profile file:

```ini
# ~/.local/share/konsole/<your profile>.profile
[Appearance]
ColorScheme=subway-seat-tunnel
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Settings › Edit Current Profile › Appearance, or the profile file:

```ini
# ~/.local/share/konsole/<your profile>.profile
[Appearance]
ColorScheme=subway-seat-enamel
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
